function: Recipe definitions: Engineering.Enhancements (every IRecipeListDefinition recipe in this group)
description: The built data of every recipe in the group: skill, category, level, practice rank limit, quantity, crafted item, active flag, enhancement type and slots, research cost modifier, components in the order the definition adds them (resref x quantity), requirements (class and field values in declaration order) and the effect lines (count and fingerprint).
inputs: 342 of the 3355 recipes, sorted by recipe id. Groups: Smithery by armor/accessory or weapon categories, Fabrication, Agriculture, Espionage and Engineering by gear, enhancements, starship, droid parts, droid software and music. effectFingerprint is the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the lines joined with a line feed.
